newsitem.title: UK: Mexico cuts Oct Maya, Isthmus crudes to U.S/Europe.
newsitem.headline: Mexico cuts Oct Maya, Isthmus crudes to U.S/Europe.

text.p: Mexican state oil company Petroleos Mexicanos reduced by 10-20 cents its October prices for Maya and Isthmus crudes to U.S. and European lifters, a Pemex official said on Tuesday.

As a result of the change, Maya loaded in October for the United States will be priced at a 10 cent discount of $1.20 a barrel to the Pemex formula compared to -$1.10 in September. Isthmus was cut 20 cents to a 90 cent discount compared with a 70 cent discount in September for the high quality crude.
Olmeca was kept unchanged at a 40 cent premium.
For European customers, Pemex cut Maya by 20 cents.
This took Maya for October to a discount of $1.05 under the Pemex formula compared with an 85 cent discount in September.
Isthmus crude was also cut 20 cents to a nine cent premium compared with 29 cents in September.
Far Eastern lifters will pay -$2.60 for Maya in October instead of -$2.70 in September. Isthmus was unchanged at +55 cents.
